files.content:
# Slack notifications (block: slack)

Post to Slack from app events (signups, orders...) and get security alerts, through an incoming webhook or a bot token. Values are escaped so user data cannot ping @channel, bursts become one digest, 429 waits for Retry-After, and nothing blocks a request. Zero dependencies.

The code is in `app/blocks/slack/` and belongs to this project. Options go in `calm.config.js` under `blocks['slack']`; secrets go in `.env`.

## For AI agents

- Read `app/blocks/slack/index.js` first: `render()` and `escape()` at the top, then `deliver()` (retries) and the security digest at the bottom.
- Add a notification by mapping an event in calm.config.js `blocks.slack.events`, not by calling Slack from routes or services.
- Invariant: every value that can come from users goes through `escape()` (templates do it for placeholders). Never build Slack text by string concatenation of user data: it allows <!channel> pings and disguised links.
- Template strings are trusted (they may contain <!here> on purpose); functions in `events` must escape what they interpolate (`escape` is passed as the third argument).
- Never await Slack in a request: use `ctx.app.ext.slack.post()` (background). `send()` awaits and throws, for jobs and scripts.
- Secrets: `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` and `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` live in `.env` only. A webhook URL is a credential, never log or commit it.
- Security alerts: tune `security.maxPerWindow`, `security.window` and `security.ignore`; keep the digest so an attack cannot flood the channel.
- Do not put emails, tokens or IP addresses of users in messages unless the team agreed: the channel is not access controlled like the API.
- 429 answers are retried after Retry-After; 400/401/403/404/410 and errors like channel_not_found or invalid_auth are permanent and not retried.
- Tests: point `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` or `apiBase` at a local node:http server.

## Official documentation

- [Sending messages using incoming webhooks](https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks)
- [chat.postMessage](https://api.slack.com/methods/chat.postMessage)
- [Formatting text (escaping)](https://api.slack.com/reference/surfaces/formatting)
- [Rate limits](https://api.slack.com/apis/rate-limits)
- [Block Kit](https://api.slack.com/block-kit)

## Usage

Set SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL (Slack app, Incoming Webhooks), or SLACK_BOT_TOKEN (chat:write scope) and SLACK_CHANNEL (a channel ID). Without them messages are only logged.
Map events to messages in calm.config.js: blocks: { slack: { events: { 'auth.registered': 'New signup: {user.name}', 'order.created': 'Order {doc.number}: {doc.total} EUR' } } }. Values are escaped; a function (payload, name) => text | { text, blocks } gives full control.
security.* events are posted as alerts (security.forbidden and security.invalid_token ignored): maxPerWindow per window, the rest in one digest. Send from code: await ctx.app.ext.slack.send('text' | blocks | { text, blocks, channel }), or ctx.app.ext.slack.post(...) to fire and forget.

## Environment variables

- `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`
- `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN`
- `SLACK_CHANNEL`

More: https://docs.calmapi.dev/blocks/slack
